Our collection of the best Laravel dashboards offers the most reliable templates for all web applications you work on.

After reviewing over fifty possible candidates, we settled on these twenty-two.

We based our selection on multiple factors since we deliver the best.

These Laravel dashboards offer flexible designs and layouts, great color selection, and heaps of features.

Plus!

Since this collection was requested from users of all skill levels, we also included a few free options.

You can use these to learn Laravel and building dashboards or for quick prototypes.

This is it. Developing an admin dashboard has never been that fun!

Enjoy.

Creative Tim Premium Laravel Templates

1. Argon

💎 15,000+ Customers • $149

Why we like it: Top-rated Laravel template with 5-star rating, 100+ elements, and comprehensive documentation for all skill levels.

Argon is at the top of the list for multiple reasons. Not only does it have a 5-star rating, engaging design and 100s of elements, but it also promises a great process of making your project a reality.

Very user-friendly if you will. In short, both beginners and professionals can profit from Argon tremendously.

If you ever encounter any inconvenience, you can always contact pro tech support or just flip through the comprehensive documentation.

Download Preview

2. Material

💎 10,000+ Customers • $149

Why we like it: Adaptable Laravel dashboard with Material Design, ready-made layouts, and perfect component harmony.

This collection includes a mix of free and premium Laravel dashboards. The Material template also comes in two versions for your convenience.

You can use Material for as many web apps as you want. It is adaptable enough to fit something niche or something general. You can customize it however you want.

Thanks to the ready-made layouts and a broad selection of practical elements, material saves you A LOT of time.

Download Preview

3. Black

💎 8,000+ Customers • $149

Why we like it: Striking dark Laravel dashboard with mobile-ready design and 90+ hours of development time saved.

Many users have complained about the lack of dark designs. To your luck, here is Black. This striking Laravel dashboard is everything you need to create a mobile-ready admin.

Creative-Tim spent about ninety hours completing Black with all its perks. Yes, 90 hours, saved!

Your custom-made application deserves a custom-made admin panel. You will attain a great outcome that will take you little time to complete. Even as a beginner!

Download Preview

4. Now UI

💎 7,000+ Customers • $149

Why we like it: Flexible and extensible Laravel template with beginner-friendly code and professional admin creation.

Getting projects done will now be much quicker. If you still haven’t find the right Laravel dashboard, the chances are high that Now UI will do the trick.

A flexible and extensible template that you can modify however you want. OR. You use it out-of-the-box and save even more time.

Now UI is here to serve all its users very well. The code is also built with beginners in mind, so no matter how skilled you are, Now UI ensures you the creation of a professional admin.

Download Preview

5. Paper

💎 6,000+ Customers • $149

Why we like it: Modern mobile-first design with appealing color choices, 160 elements, and ready-made background options.

If only I could tell what, but something appeals to me regarding Paper. Secretly, this is my favorite Laravel dashboard.

It has this nice color choice with a modern, mobile-first design that creates a pleasant atmosphere. Keep in mind, no need to stick with the default configuration.

While making custom adjustments, you can also pick from ready-made active and sidebar background colors.

Download Preview

6. White

💎 5,000+ Customers • $149

Why we like it: Light mode Laravel template with gradient details, 200 elements, and comprehensive admin features.

I mentioned White earlier when discussing the Black Laravel template. This is the same dashboard, just in light mode.

There’s no need to configure the dark edition if you can just go with this bright version. Note: The gradient detail spices things up, right?

Along with the great styling options, White also offers an array of elements (200!) that make for one hell of a dashboard.

Download Preview

7. Light

💎 4,000+ Customers • $149

Why we like it: Lightweight Laravel dashboard with simple creative design and fast performance across all devices.

Light is one of the lightest Laravel dashboards on the market today, and there are two good reasons for that.

First, it has a simple but creative design that creates great content distribution. Second, it has a lightweight structure that performs fast and seamlessly across different devices and platforms.

There’s no bloat when it comes to Light. There is no fancy stuff and no other unnecessary elements that cause distractions.

Download Preview

ThemeForest Premium Laravel Templates

The most popular and well-maintained Laravel admin templates from ThemeForest, trusted by thousands of developers worldwide. If you’re considering alternatives to Laravel, you might also want to explore our comprehensive guide to React admin templates or Vue admin dashboards for different frontend approaches.

8. Metronic Laravel

💎 120,000+ Customers • $42

Why we like it: World’s #1 selling admin template with unmatched Laravel integration, 40+ layouts, and support for 8+ frameworks.

Metronic Laravel stands as the ultimate admin dashboard solution trusted by 120,000+ developers worldwide. Features complete Laravel integration with authentication, user management, and CRUD operations pre-configured. Includes 40+ unique prebuilt layouts, 1000+ UI components, and seamless integration with React, Vue, and Angular. Perfect for enterprise Laravel applications requiring professional polish and extensive customization.

Download Preview

9. Vuexy Laravel

💎 23,000+ Sales • $42

Why we like it: Most developer-friendly Laravel template combining Laravel backend with Vue.js frontend and atomic design system.

Vuexy Laravel delivers exceptional developer experience by combining Laravel’s robust backend with Vue.js reactive frontend. Features 30+ Laravel pages, 60+ UI components, pre-built authentication system, and seamless API integration. The atomic design system ensures consistent, scalable development while Vue.js provides reactive user interfaces perfect for modern Laravel applications.

Download Preview

10. Materialize Laravel

💎 21,000+ Sales • $35

Why we like it: #1 selling Material Design Laravel template with Google’s design principles and Laravel authentication integration.

Materialize Laravel brings Google’s Material Design 2 to Laravel applications with seamless framework integration. Features advanced animations, comprehensive component library, pre-built Laravel authentication, and CRUD operations. Includes 5 niche dashboards, 10 Laravel applications, and updates aligned with Material Design guidelines. Perfect for Laravel projects requiring beautiful, consistent Material Design interfaces.

Download Preview

11. Frest Laravel

💎 15,000+ Sales • $35

Why we like it: Most comprehensive Laravel Bootstrap 5 template with clean design and extensive Laravel-specific features.

Frest Laravel combines clean aesthetics with powerful Laravel functionality, offering vertical and horizontal layouts, light/dark modes, and RTL support. Built specifically for Laravel developers with pre-configured authentication, database migrations, and API endpoints. Includes 40+ Laravel pages, advanced components, and seamless integration with Laravel’s ecosystem.

Download Preview

12. OneUI Laravel

💎 10,000+ Sales • $35

Why we like it: Super flexible Laravel template with included Laravel 11 starter kit and comprehensive UI framework.

OneUI Laravel provides unmatched flexibility for modern Laravel development with included Laravel 11 starter kit and comprehensive UI framework. Features responsive design, extensive Laravel documentation, and modular architecture that scales from simple dashboards to complex enterprise Laravel applications. Perfect for developers seeking multi-framework Laravel support.

Download Preview

13. Sneat Laravel Pro

💎 8,000+ Sales • $35

Why we like it: Most powerful Laravel Bootstrap 5 template with 6 unique layouts and Laravel 11 optimization.

Sneat Laravel offers exceptional power and flexibility with 6 unique layouts specifically optimized for Laravel development. Features Laravel 11 compatibility, advanced Laravel components, multiple color schemes, and developer-friendly Laravel code structure. Perfect for creating sophisticated Laravel admin interfaces with minimal setup time and maximum Laravel integration.

Download Preview

14. Skote Laravel

💎 15,000+ Sales • $39

Why we like it: Feature-rich Laravel 12 template with multi-lingual support and comprehensive Laravel integration.

Skote Laravel is a fully featured premium admin dashboard template built specifically for Laravel 12 with developer-friendly code and multi-language support. Features Bootstrap 5.3.5 integration, 7 different Laravel layouts, RTL/LTR support, and is perfect for Laravel-based SaaS, eCommerce, CRM, and CMS applications with complete Laravel backend integration.

Download Preview

15. Minia Laravel

💎 4,000+ Sales • $32

Why we like it: Lightweight Laravel 11 admin template with exceptional performance and clean code architecture.

Minia Laravel offers a simple and beautiful admin template built specifically for Laravel 11 with Bootstrap and webpack integration. Features 6+ Laravel layouts, Dark/Light modes managed by SCSS, and excellent performance optimization. Perfect for Laravel developers seeking a lightweight yet feature-rich admin solution with clean Laravel code structure.

Download Preview

16. Velzon Laravel

💎 4,500+ Sales • $39

Why we like it: Modern responsive Laravel template with 6 dashboards and comprehensive Laravel ecosystem integration.

Velzon Laravel is a fully responsive premium Laravel template built with Laravel 12 support. Features 6 different Laravel dashboards, 12+ Laravel apps, 165+ pages, and complete Laravel ecosystem integration. Includes advanced Laravel features like authentication, middleware support, and database integrations perfect for large-scale Laravel applications.

Download Preview

Professional Laravel Admin Solutions

For developers seeking specialized Laravel admin panel solutions with advanced CRUD capabilities and Laravel-specific features. If you’re looking for framework-agnostic options, our comprehensive admin templates guide covers the best dashboard solutions across all technologies:

17. CoreUI Laravel

💎 Free/Pro Options Available

Why we like it: Leading Laravel admin template used by Fortune 500 companies with comprehensive Laravel integration and professional support.

CoreUI Laravel delivers enterprise-grade admin capabilities specifically built for Laravel applications. Features advanced Laravel components, comprehensive documentation, and seamless Laravel ecosystem integration. Trusted by Fortune 500 companies for mission-critical Laravel applications requiring professional-level features and ongoing Laravel-specific technical support.

Download Preview

18. Orchid Platform

💎 Free Open Source

Why we like it: Open-source Laravel CRUD interface with code-driven development and flexible Laravel admin panel creation.

Orchid Platform is a powerful open-source Laravel package for rapid admin panel development. Features Laravel-native CRUD interface, code-driven development approach, form builder, table filtering, and text search specifically designed for Laravel. Perfect for developers who prefer Laravel-centric development with complete control over their admin panel architecture.

Download Preview

19. Laravel Backpack

💎 Freemium Model

Why we like it: Flexible Laravel admin panel builder with extensive customization using familiar Laravel patterns and CRUD operations.

Laravel Backpack provides the most flexibility for deep Laravel customizations using familiar Laravel patterns. Features comprehensive CRUD operations, Laravel-native development approach, and extensive Laravel ecosystem integration. Used to power everything from presentation websites to complex ERPs with Laravel backend. Perfect for Laravel developers requiring maximum customization flexibility.

Download Preview

Free Laravel Templates

High-quality free Laravel admin templates perfect for learning, prototyping, and open-source projects:

20. Argon Laravel (Free)

💎 Free (30,000+ Downloads)

Why we like it: Free Laravel template with 100 elements, plugins, and example pages for rapid Laravel prototyping.

You don’t always need to pay to benefit from a Laravel dashboard. Since Argon pro is our favorite, the free versions are the same.

With approx. 30k downloads, Argon shows that it’s a powerful alternative that comes with no hidden fees. A great way to test the waters before upgrading to pro.

You still get a collection of one hundred elements, multiple plugins and several ready-to-use examples pages. You don’t need to do anything from scratch. Rather improve the available material and enjoy the quick dashboard execution.

Download Preview

21. Material Laravel (Free)

💎 Free (24,000+ Downloads)

Why we like it: Free Material Design Laravel template with 60 elements, Laravel authentication, and Material Design components.

I am sure many skipped the premium Material and jumped straight here. You did the right thing! Material will do you extremely well if you are looking for a free Laravel dashboard.

With over 24k+ downloads, Material is a popular template that already helped many users do magical things.

However, the free demo contains much less material than the pro version. Still, it includes sixty elements, two plugins, three example pages, and some neat styling options.

Download Preview

22. Black Laravel (Free)

💎 Free (15,000+ Downloads)

Why we like it: Free dark Laravel template with responsive layout, color skins, and comprehensive Laravel setup guide.

Yes, here it is, the free dark Laravel template, Black. A great approach to starting with your development process is by going free and then upgrade to pro.

The free dashboard already has a decent portion of the material to quickly sort out an admin. A quick setup guide also ensures everyone enjoys a smooth sail.

You can pick any of the three main color skins, make other styling configurations and extra customizations, and then you are all set to go live.

Download Preview

Choosing the Right Laravel Dashboard

When selecting a Laravel dashboard template, consider your project’s specific requirements, Laravel version compatibility, and long-term maintenance needs. Premium templates offer commercial support, advanced Laravel features, and regular updates, while free templates provide excellent starting points for Laravel prototypes and learning projects.

For a broader perspective on admin dashboard options beyond Laravel, explore our comprehensive admin templates collection which covers all major frameworks and technologies.

All templates listed are built following Laravel best practices, ensuring compatibility, security, and ease of integration with your Laravel applications.
